board.name: South Dakota Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners (SDBMOE), with a Physician Assistant Council

licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA)
licence.renewalDeadline: Annual; renewal application filed before May 1 each year (ARSD 20:52:01:09). Statute says annually on a date set by the board. Note: ARSD 20:52:01:09 still cites SDCL 36-4A-32, which SL 2025 ch 149 repealed; the May 1 filing date in the rule has not been amended.

ce.hoursNote: 30 hours of board approved post graduate study in the preceding 12 months, every annual renewal. Proof of current NCCPA certification satisfies the requirement.
ce.categoryRules: Post graduate studies approved by the board; no AAPA Category 1 split stated in statute or rule
ce.nccpaNote: Not required for renewal itself, but NCCPA certification is required to practise without a collaborative agreement; a PA who loses NCCPA certification must return to a collaborative agreement.
ce.controlledSubstanceCe: No state controlled substance CE found in statute or rule; federal DEA one-time 8 hour SUD training (MATE) applies to DEA registrants.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Collaborative agreement (board approved form) with an SD physician required until the PA is NCCPA certified and files an affidavit of at least 6,000 practice hours (effective July 1, 2025, SL 2025 ch 149). Agreement kept at the primary practice site and provided to the board on request; PA notifies the board in writing when an agreement terminates. No periodic renewal of the agreement is stated.
practice.notes: Board online account has an option (since July 1, 2025) to request the 6,000 hour exemption affidavit.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: South Dakota Controlled Substance Registration (Department of Health) required, and must be obtained before DEA registration. PAs may prescribe drugs other than Schedule I (SDCL 36-4A-26.1(6)). The state registration expires together with the DEA registration (ARSD 44:58:03:01).

board.name: South Dakota Board of Nursing (CNP practice also governed by SDCL 36-9A)

rn.renewalDeadline: Biennially on the licensee's birth date (initial licence expires on the birth date in the second calendar year after issue)
rn.ceNote: No continuing education hour requirement found for RN renewal. Instead, active status requires nursing employment of at least 140 hours in any 12 month period over the preceding 6 years, or 480 hours accumulated in 6 years, or a board approved refresher course.

aprn.title: CNP (Certified Nurse Practitioner); licensed under SDCL 36-9A, not under the 'APRN' definition in 36-9-1
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: Separate CNP licence from the Board of Nursing; requires an SD RN licence or multistate privilege
aprn.ceNote: No CE hour requirement for CNP renewal; renewal requires evidence of current national certification, an unencumbered RN licence or privilege, and a no misconduct affidavit. Expiry aligns with the SD RN licence, or the second birthday after issue for a multistate RN privilege holder.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: No separate state prescriptive authority certificate (prescriptive authority rules chapter 20:62:04 repealed); prescribing including Schedule II is in the CNP scope. A South Dakota Controlled Substance Registration (Department of Health) is required for controlled substances, before DEA registration. The state registration expires together with the DEA registration (ARSD 44:58:03:01); CNPs must also register with the SD PDMP before prescribing controlled substances (ARSD 20:62:03:11).
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: None found at state level; federal DEA one-time 8 hour SUD training (MATE) applies.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: A new CNP without 1,040 licensed practice hours in the preceding five years submits a written collaborative agreement with an SD physician, CNP or CNM (collaborator: unencumbered licence, at least two years in a comparable area). After 1,040 hours the licensee submits evidence to the board to inactivate the agreement.
